title: SERIE A'S TOP SCORER REPORTEDLY COST €2.5M. NOW SPURS ARE ASKING.
description:
Reportedly €2.5M. Now Gustavo Varela tops the Serie A scoring chart.

He is 21 and Monza are still in the relegation zone. Somebody tell the other ten. Nine league goals, eleven in all competitions, with a Coppa Italia brace. Eleven goals in eleven games.

His first senior Portugal call-up came this November. Tottenham have made an enquiry, Liverpool are watching every week, and Juventus and Napoli want a January deal.

Goal says Monza want €35M. That's fourteen times what they reportedly paid Benfica. No bank offers that rate.

Would you pay €35M for him? Yes or no, and say which club should buy him.
